//: Library type-gen for the JS+JSDoc glue, pacer's baseline verbatim: type-check the public src under the strict 2026 settings, then emit .d.ts (+ maps) into types/. `npm run build:types` runs `tsc`; `npm run typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit`. noUncheckedIndexedAccess is ON, and the wasm-boundary index access it flags is resolved at named seams — every wire ordinal is read through a `?? fallback` against a mirror array, so an ordinal a newer module invented degrades to a known value instead of to `undefined`. isolatedDeclarations is intentionally absent: tsc forbids it with allowJs (TS5053).
